ios.desc:
Girl Math makes saving money fun! Turn everyday “I just saved…” moments into real progress toward buying the things you want. Set a goal, log small wins in seconds, and watch your progress bar fill. No bank linking, just simple, motivating tracking that turns everyday choices into rewarding results.

— Why people love it —
- Save for trips, fashion/beauty, tech, gifts, or debt payoff, and see progress build every day.
- Turn tiny decisions (skip a latte, use a coupon, sell an item) into real savings.
- Share progress with friends using cute, high‑res “receipt” images of your wins.
- Stay motivated with fun celebrations (yes, confetti) when you complete goals.

— App Features —
- Create goals: name it, set a target, choose a category.
- Add wins fast: jot a quick note like “skipping daily coffee” and the amount you saved.
- Smart allocation: wins automatically split across active goals. No manual math.
- Progress dashboard: totals and recent wins keep you motivated at a glance.
- Celebration screen: complete a goal and enjoy a confetti moment.
- Shareable receipt: export a clean, high‑res “Girl Math receipt” of all wins.
- Private by design: on‑device storage, no bank linking.
- Girl Math Pro (optional): unlock unlimited goals so you can manifest more than one thing.
- Restore purchases: switch devices or reinstall and keep your Pro access.

— From the Developer —
Hi! I’m Jerry, the creator of Girl Math. I built this to turn small daily wins into big goals. My focus is on keeping things simple and motivating. No bank connections, no spreadsheets. I’m actively improving Girl Math and would love your feedback!

— Subscription Details —
- Girl Math Pro is an auto‑renewing subscription that unlocks unlimited goals.
- Length: 1 month.
- Price: shown in‑app and varies by region.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
- Renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the period.
- Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy: https://www.jerryfeng.com/stuff/girl-math/privacy/

quotes.text:
Girl Math started as a weekend project when I realized my friend was terrible at saving money but amazing at justifying purchases with elaborate mental gymnastics.

Then I thought: what if that same creative energy actually helped you save?

The app turns "I didn't spend" moments into visible progress toward things you really want. Set goals, log tiny wins in seconds (skipped a latte, walked instead of Uber), and watch a satisfying progress bar fill up with haptics, confetti, and a playful receipt at 100%.

Under the fun, it's a habit loop: immediate dopamine for the right behavior, one active goal for focus, and daily micro-wins that build real momentum. No spreadsheets, no guilt trips. Just making your small choices feel like they add up to something bigger.

Runs entirely on-device with no accounts or tracking. Just you, your goals, and your wins.

I'd love your feedback, and if you've got a favorite girl math moment, drop it below so I can add more examples to inspire users!
